title: The Laurel-Star Gate: Ascension Seal
description: The Laurel-Star Gate unfolds across Laurel-Star Gate summit above the arena with cracked champion plinths, pushing a one active Olympian Titan to prove elite balanced pressure, precision, dueling, morale momentum. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: The Laurel-Star Gate: Ascension Seal advances Laurel Senate Trials: Olympus turns the reopened Gate into public trial law, forcing glory to become defense instead of vanity. It directly tests the faction tension: Glory unites them in public and divides them in private; every victory creates a jealous shadow.
